_comment: PointsBet competition name -> tourney_name in matches_with_holdout.parquet. PointsBet names Masters events by city ('ATP Montreal'); the match history names them by the event ('Canada Masters'), so the fuzzy resolver in Reference.tournament matches neither and the fixture is skipped. Data, not code: an entry here shows up in a diff. Only map a name when the event is unambiguously the same tournament. Reviewed and committed, same rules as player_aliases.json.
